senses.gloss:
m. (-मिः)
The third MANU.
E.
उत्तम, and इञ् patron. aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Going or coming in a northerly direction.
E.
उत्तर, पथ for पथिन् a road, ठक् aff.

m. (-दिः)
A name of DHRUVA, in mythology the son of UTTĀNAPĀDA, and grandson of the first MANU; in astronomy, the polar star, or the north pole itself.
E.
उत्तानपाद, and इञ् patronymic aff.
